instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: Run 'npm install three @types/three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge' immediately.
2. FONT SETUP: Add 'Syne' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
3. 3D IMPLEMENTATION: Create a separate component 'Scene.jsx' for the 3D canvas. Keep it lightweight. Use <Canvas dpr={[1, 2]}> for performance.
4. GLASSMORPHISM: Apply the glass classes defined in 'components.navbar' and 'components.cards' strictly.
5. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for backgrounds and the crawled logo URLs for the client section.
6. SECTIONS: Build Hero, Logo Marquee, Bento Grid Services, Methodology Steps, Testimonials, and Contact Form.
7. NO PLACEHOLDERS: Use the real content provided in 'content_map'.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all buttons and inputs.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it is the main H1.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the dark background.
Mobile responsiveness is priority #1. Stack the Bento grid on mobile.
